jobs.description:
Pay Range:

$105,654.00 - $174,330.00

Country:

United States of America

Address:

1401 PACIFIC AVE

City:

DALLAS, TX 75202

FLSA:

Exempt

Professionals:

01 - Official Administrator (EEO-4-United States of America), 1B - Managers and Directors (EEO-SubCategory)

General Summary:

The Director Reliability Engineering & Streetcar provides strategic leadership for transit asset management, state of good repair initiatives, pursue and lead system resiliency projects, and oversees the Dallas Streetcar program. This position oversees transit asset planning, maintenance, rehabilitation, replacement, lifecycle programs, and related operating and capital budgets. Collaborates across departments and with external stakeholders to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient transit service while supporting long-term agency goals and sustainable asset investment strategies.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
:

Oversee the State of Good Repair (SGR) Program and Asset Management Division including administration of the Transit Asset Management (TAM) Plan.
Lead strategic asset management initiatives for vehicles, facilities, infrastructure, systems, and streetcar assets.
Responsible for coordinating accident/incident condition assessment processes.
Monitor asset condition and performance data and provide recommendations to Executive Leadership for capital planning and risk-based investment decisions.
Develop and manage short- and long-range replacement, rehabilitation, modernization, and capital improvement programs.
Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, and other departments regarding repair, replacement, and modernization activities.
Consult with and direct various groups and teams within the agency on reliability engineering topics and system vulnerabilities.
Serve as DART liaison with the City of Dallas regarding Dallas Streetcar operations, maintenance, capital improvements, and stakeholder engagement.
Lead meetings with internal stakeholders, regulators, consultants, contractors, funding partners, and external agencies.
Oversee asset inventory, lifecycle planning, condition assessments, performance reporting, and configuration management processes.
Provide technical analysis, troubleshooting support, and reliability improvement strategies for bus, rail, streetcar, facilities, and infrastructure assets.
Provide program management for the DART Transform Program, advancing major system investments including new light rail vehicles and bus fleet, resiliency initiatives, and the Unified Signals Project to enhance system reliability and performance.
Support procurements, solicitations, scope development, technical evaluations, cost estimates, schedules, and budgets.
Review engineering designs and recommend enhancements that improve safety, reliability, maintainability, and operational performance.
Support testing, commissioning, validation, acceptance, and turnover of new and upgraded assets.
Promote innovation, continuous improvement, and implementation of industry best practices and emerging technologies.
Manage operating and capital budgets associated with SGR, TAM, and Streetcar programs.
Ensure compliance with FTA, state, local, environmental, safety, and agency requirements.
Prepare executive reports, performance metrics, project updates, budget forecasts, and resource allocation plans.
Oversee consultant, contractor, and vendor performance.
Provide leadership, staff development, accountability, safety culture, and continuous improvement.
Performs other related duties as assigned.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

Note
: An equivalent combination of related education and experience may be substituted for the below stated minimums excluding High School Diploma, GED, Licenses, or Certifications.

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Urban Planning, Architecture or related field.
Five (5) years progressively responsible experience in transportation, vehicle systems, equipment project management, and technical support to include experience supervising staff engaged in operations, technical support, project management, and configuration management programs.
Valid Texas Class A, B, or C driver’s license, no Driving While Intoxicated (DWI) conviction within the last (60) consecutive months, not more than (1) DWI on driving record, and not more than (3) convictions of moving violations within the last (36) consecutive months on driving record in order to operate DART non-revenue vehicles.
Pass a physical (medical) examination, which includes a drug screen in order to operate DART revenue and non-revenue vehicles.

WORKING CONDITIONS
:

Works in an environment where there is minimum exposure to dust, noise, or temperature. May be moderately exposed to unpleasant working conditions to include dust, noise, temperature, weather, petroleum products, and chemicals while visiting DART's operating facilities, assuming incumbent is observing all policies and procedures, safety precautions and regulations, and using all protective clothing and devices provided.

Note:
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. The statements are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All employees may perform other duties as assigned.

Open until qualified applicants are identified.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

Panorama Education operates in the K-12 education technology sector, addressing the challenge of providing comprehensive student insights to modern school systems. By integrating academic, attendance, behavior, and engagement data with AI, the program enables educators to fully understand each student and make informed decisions. Supporting 15 million students across 2,000 districts nationwide, the organization has a significant impact on student outcomes.

About the Opportunity:

The SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER, PLATFORM leads the team responsible for the foundational capabilities that support the organization's products, including shared services, core infrastructure, developer tools, and operational standards. This role ensures the platform remains robust and scalable as the program grows, enabling rapid and secure product development. The manager collaborates with product leadership to align technical direction with strategic goals and supports the integration of AI workloads into the platform.

Responsibilities:

Lead and grow a team of senior and staff platform engineers, setting clear expectations and providing direct feedback.
Guide technical decisions on architecture, infrastructure, and system design, focusing on high-impact work.
Manage platform delivery from planning to production, defining and maintaining platform health metrics.
Develop strong operational practices including on-call and incident management with SRE.
Collaborate with AI platform and security teams to ensure infrastructure supports AI capabilities securely and efficiently.
Work with product management to shape and prioritize the platform roadmap.
Represent platform engineering in cross-team initiatives and provide leadership with transparent updates.
Ensure platform capabilities comply with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements, especially regarding student data.

Requirements:

Minimum 8 years software engineering experience, including 5 years managing engineers, preferably in platform-related teams.
Proven ability to manage senior and staff engineers with a leadership style based on clarity and trust.
Strong technical credibility with hands-on experience, especially with AWS; experience with Terraform and Kubernetes is a plus.
Experience partnering with product teams to deliver shared roadmaps and coordinating across engineering, security, and operations.
Disciplined in delivery, scope management, and defining completion criteria.
Focus on developer experience improvements such as CI/CD and internal tooling tied to productivity and retention.
Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks like SOC 2 and FERPA, with expertise in data protection.
Experience with scalable monitoring and observability.
Understanding of AI workload infrastructure demands and integration of AI-assisted tools and workflows.
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field is preferred.

Pay Range and Compensation Package:

Base salary range: $194,051 - $285,369 USD annually.
Compensation includes annual bonuses or commissions, equity awards, and region-specific health and welfare benefits.

Benefits & Perks:

401(k) plan with employer match.
Health, dental, vision, life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability coverage.
Flexible spending accounts for health care and dependent care.
Wellness and work-from-home reimbursements.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Analytics & BI Engineering
jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

The organization operates within the analytics and business intelligence industry, addressing challenges related to consistent and reliable data reporting across multiple business functions and brands. It focuses on delivering governed metrics and reporting solutions that build trust in data and empower business decisions at scale.

About the Opportunity:

The SR. MANAGER, ANALYTICS & BI ENGINEERING leads the engineering function responsible for enterprise metric definitions and reporting delivery. This role is critical to establishing consistent, certified metrics and ensuring high-quality reporting assets that support data-driven decision-making. The position oversees both internal and external teams, implements engineering standards, and builds analytics capabilities across the organization.

Responsibilities:

Own the semantic layer as the source for enterprise metric definitions, ensuring design, certification, and enforcement.
Implement metric definitions in collaboration with data governance and product functions.
Manage quality, consistency, and certification of metrics and reports.
Ensure correctness, performance, and maintainability of reporting assets.
Define and enforce engineering standards for metrics and reporting.
Manage workspace structure, dataset certification, and access security.
Lead and mentor analytics engineers, BI developers, and analysts.
Establish metrics engineering as a formal discipline with standards and career paths.
Build delivery models and intake processes for metrics and reporting.
Lead analytics functions serving business areas with certified metrics-based reporting.
Develop analytics capabilities within business functions and transition ownership.
Direct external BI delivery resources, handling capacity and quality.
Provide metrics and reporting engineering support to cross-functional data teams.
Develop reusable semantic models and reporting patterns for consistency.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field; Master’s preferred.
8–12 years of experience in enterprise metrics, reporting, and BI solutions.
3–5+ years managing analytics or BI engineering teams.
Hands-on experience with enterprise reporting platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik).
Proficiency with semantic layer or OLAP modeling technologies.
Experience managing external delivery partners and contractor benches.
Proven ability to lead analytics teams serving business functions.
Experience building analytics capabilities within business units preferred.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms, preferably AWS, and dbt-modeled data.
Expertise in dimensional and semantic modeling, metric definition, SQL, and BI calculation languages.
Strong understanding of BI platform architecture and governance.
Ability to create scalable delivery standards and patterns.
Effective leadership, coaching, and talent development skills.
Skilled at balancing technical excellence with operational stability.
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication abilities.

The pay range and compensation package for this role will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or national origin.

jobs.title: Director, Provider Technology and Innovation Strategy
jobs.description:
Great companies need great teams to propel their operations. Join the group that solves business challenges and enhances the way we work and grow. Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values your contributions and puts a premium on work flexibility, learning, and career development.

Summary

Gainwell is seeking an experienced and results-driven, technically minded business leader to manage market, industry, & competitor analysis and product innovation strategies across the Provider Solutions portfolio. Reporting directly to the Senior Vice President and General Manager of Provider Solutions, this leader will be accountable for evaluation of existing products, defining opportunities for enhancement and optimization, and identification new product development to address market opportunities. This role will act as the face of provider product strategy and innovation, driving cross-discipline alignment on product technology and process advancement. A successful candidate will be highly organized, strategic, collaborative, creative, and have exceptional problem solving, analytical, communication and interpersonal skills. They will be a visionary in software products and technology advancement, drawing from best and emerging practices across the technology industry. They will be accountable for overseeing all technology and product advancements from concept through delivery across the Provider portfolio.

Your role in our mission

Conduct Medicaid federal, market, policy, and competitor analysis to inform product strategy and innovation roadmaps.
Analyze and assess target market, and thoroughly understand competitive landscape and market position of solution portfolio, along with federal (CMS) and state mandates.
Develop business cases for new solutions that will add significant value and help Gainwell, and its clients, achieve business success.
Interface with engineering and business leads to derive opportunities and identify technology advancement opportunities and prioritize based on impact.
Closely align with Provider solutions team to understand current technology and how to evolve existing solutions over time through organic and inorganic transformation.
Coordinate strategies, work, and communicate effectively between corresponding leadership roles in Product, Engineering, Implementation, Delivery/Operations, Marketing, and Sales to drive achievement of innovation goals.
Produce and deliver executive reports on technology and innovation vision, strategy, and finances on a routine basis.

What We're Looking For

7-10 years of technology consulting and/or strategy management, with extensive exposure to product management, engineering, implementations, sales/marketing, and delivery.
5–8 years in healthcare strategy consulting and product operations (public sector a plus).
Excellent communicator with a knack for distilling complexity into clarity.
Highly organized, proactive, and discreet—comfortable navigating ambiguity.
Strong understanding of Medicaid, Provider enrollment processes, and CMS regulations (relevant commercial experience is acceptable).
Ability to drive multi-year product technology and innovation roadmaps to achieve measurable business transformation.
Proven achievement bringing new products to market that drive net new business growth.
Experience overseeing multiple complex technology projects and tracking from concept to completion.
Expertise in Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) solutions is preferred.

What You Should Expect In This Role

This opportunity is 100% remote within the United States with opportunity to travel for work up to 10% annually.

The deadline to submit applications for this posting is October 16 2026.

The pay range for this position is $137,100.00 - $195,800.00 per year, however, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region, internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Put your passion to work at Gainwell. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. All salaried, full-time candidates are eligible for our generous, flexible vacation policy, a 401(k) employer match, comprehensive health benefits, and educational assistance. We also have a variety of leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

We believe nothing is impossible when you bring together people who care deeply about making healthcare work better for everyone. Build your career with Gainwell, an industry leader. You’ll be joining a company where collaboration, innovation, and inclusion fuel our growth. Learn more about Gainwell at our company website and visit our Careers site for all available job role openings.

Gainwell Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer, where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition), age, sexual orientation, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Gainwell Technologies defines “wages” and “wage rates” to include “all forms of pay, including, but not limited to, salary, overtime pay, bonuses, stock, stock options, profit sharing and bonus plans, life insurance, vacation and holiday pay, cleaning or gasoline allowances, hotel accommodations, reimbursement for travel expenses, and benefits.

jobs.title: Director, Technology Solution Marketing
jobs.description:
Bentley Systems

Location:
Philadelphia or Denver, US (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Bentley is seeking a marketing leader to define and drive the market narrative for our core technology platforms, including digital twins, AI, connected data, and platform capabilities.

Reporting to the VP of Product & Industry Marketing, this role shapes how Bentley's technology strategy is understood internally and differentiated externally. You will partner with executive leadership to develop long-term technology narratives, guide thought leadership, and ensure consistent positioning across products, industries, and go-to-market programs.

As a player-coach, you will lead, coach, and develop a team of solution marketers while remaining accountable for one or more strategic technology solution areas. Success in this role requires executive presence, exceptional storytelling, technical curiosity, and the ability to influence across a global, matrixed organization.

Responsibilities

Narrative & Executive Partnership

Act as a trusted thought partner with executive leadership to shape Bentley's long-term technology positioning and strategic direction.
Serve as the primary marketing advisor for Bentley's horizontal technology portfolio.
Translate technology strategy into differentiated market positioning and strategic messaging.

Messaging, Positioning & Thought Leadership

Define messaging frameworks for Bentley's core technology platforms.
Ensure consistent positioning across industries, products, and go-to-market initiatives.
Develop differentiated value propositions grounded in customer outcomes.
Drive Bentley's technology thought leadership by identifying emerging trends and partnering with executives on key industry narratives.
Engage analysts, customers, and industry influencers to validate and strengthen Bentley's market positioning.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop a team of solution marketers.
Personally lead strategic technology solution initiatives while remaining hands-on in messaging and positioning.
Align team priorities with business objectives and evolving market opportunities.

Go-to-Market Alignment

Partner with Product Marketing, Industry Marketing, Campaigns, Sales, and Corporate Marketing to activate technology messaging globally.
Establish scalable frameworks, standards, and processes for consistent execution across the organization.

Market Insight & Technology Fluency

Maintain deep expertise in AI, digital twins, connected data, cloud platforms, and emerging enterprise technology trends.
Synthesize analyst, customer, competitive, and market insights into forward-looking positioning and strategic recommendations.

Qualifications

15+ years of experience in B2B enterprise technology marketing, including leadership in platform, AI, cloud, data, or digital transformation solutions.
Demonstrated success influencing executive leaders and shaping company-wide technology strategy and messaging.
Proven ability to lead through influence across a complex global matrix organization.
Exceptional messaging and positioning capabilities, with evidence of simplifying complex technologies.
Experience building and leading high-performing marketing teams.
Strong cross-functional leadership across product, sales, and go-to-market teams.
Technical fluency and intellectual curiosity in relevant technology domains.
Bachelor's degree required or equivalent training or experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in infrastructure, AEC, or engineering software markets.
Experience marketing horizontal technologies across multiple industries.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship.

What We Offer

A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video. 
An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction - watch this short documentary about how we got our start. 
An attractive salary and benefits package. 
A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups. 
A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

 About Bentley Systems

Around the world, infrastructure professionals rely on software from Bentley Systems to help them design, build, and operate better and more resilient infrastructure for transportation, water, energy, cities, and more. Founded in 1984 by engineers for engineers, Bentley is the partner of choice for engineering firms and owner-operators worldwide, with software that spans engineering disciplines, industry sectors, and all phases of the infrastructure lifecycle. Through our digital twin solutions, we help infrastructure professionals unlock the value of their data to transform project delivery and asset performance. www.bentley.com

Bentley is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, pregnancy, protected veteran status, religion, national origin, age, genetic information or any other protected characteristic. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, compensation, and training. Know Your Rights as an applicant under the law.

new_jobs.title: Director, Provider Technology and Innovation Strategy
new_jobs.description:
Great companies need great teams to propel their operations. Join the group that solves business challenges and enhances the way we work and grow. Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values your contributions and puts a premium on work flexibility, learning, and career development.

Summary

Gainwell is seeking an experienced and results-driven, technically minded business leader to manage market, industry, & competitor analysis and product innovation strategies across the Provider Solutions portfolio. Reporting directly to the Senior Vice President and General Manager of Provider Solutions, this leader will be accountable for evaluation of existing products, defining opportunities for enhancement and optimization, and identification new product development to address market opportunities. This role will act as the face of provider product strategy and innovation, driving cross-discipline alignment on product technology and process advancement. A successful candidate will be highly organized, strategic, collaborative, creative, and have exceptional problem solving, analytical, communication and interpersonal skills. They will be a visionary in software products and technology advancement, drawing from best and emerging practices across the technology industry. They will be accountable for overseeing all technology and product advancements from concept through delivery across the Provider portfolio.

Your role in our mission

Conduct Medicaid federal, market, policy, and competitor analysis to inform product strategy and innovation roadmaps.
Analyze and assess target market, and thoroughly understand competitive landscape and market position of solution portfolio, along with federal (CMS) and state mandates.
Develop business cases for new solutions that will add significant value and help Gainwell, and its clients, achieve business success.
Interface with engineering and business leads to derive opportunities and identify technology advancement opportunities and prioritize based on impact.
Closely align with Provider solutions team to understand current technology and how to evolve existing solutions over time through organic and inorganic transformation.
Coordinate strategies, work, and communicate effectively between corresponding leadership roles in Product, Engineering, Implementation, Delivery/Operations, Marketing, and Sales to drive achievement of innovation goals.
Produce and deliver executive reports on technology and innovation vision, strategy, and finances on a routine basis.

What We're Looking For

7-10 years of technology consulting and/or strategy management, with extensive exposure to product management, engineering, implementations, sales/marketing, and delivery.
5–8 years in healthcare strategy consulting and product operations (public sector a plus).
Excellent communicator with a knack for distilling complexity into clarity.
Highly organized, proactive, and discreet—comfortable navigating ambiguity.
Strong understanding of Medicaid, Provider enrollment processes, and CMS regulations (relevant commercial experience is acceptable).
Ability to drive multi-year product technology and innovation roadmaps to achieve measurable business transformation.
Proven achievement bringing new products to market that drive net new business growth.
Experience overseeing multiple complex technology projects and tracking from concept to completion.
Expertise in Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) solutions is preferred.

What You Should Expect In This Role

This opportunity is 100% remote within the United States with opportunity to travel for work up to 10% annually.

The deadline to submit applications for this posting is October 16 2026.

The pay range for this position is $137,100.00 - $195,800.00 per year, however, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region, internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. Put your passion to work at Gainwell. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. All salaried, full-time candidates are eligible for our generous, flexible vacation policy, a 401(k) employer match, comprehensive health benefits, and educational assistance. We also have a variety of leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

We believe nothing is impossible when you bring together people who care deeply about making healthcare work better for everyone. Build your career with Gainwell, an industry leader. You’ll be joining a company where collaboration, innovation, and inclusion fuel our growth. Learn more about Gainwell at our company website and visit our Careers site for all available job role openings.

new_jobs.title: Director, Technology Solution Marketing
new_jobs.description:
Bentley Systems

Location:
Philadelphia or Denver, US (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Bentley is seeking a marketing leader to define and drive the market narrative for our core technology platforms, including digital twins, AI, connected data, and platform capabilities.

Reporting to the VP of Product & Industry Marketing, this role shapes how Bentley's technology strategy is understood internally and differentiated externally. You will partner with executive leadership to develop long-term technology narratives, guide thought leadership, and ensure consistent positioning across products, industries, and go-to-market programs.

As a player-coach, you will lead, coach, and develop a team of solution marketers while remaining accountable for one or more strategic technology solution areas. Success in this role requires executive presence, exceptional storytelling, technical curiosity, and the ability to influence across a global, matrixed organization.

Responsibilities

Narrative & Executive Partnership

Act as a trusted thought partner with executive leadership to shape Bentley's long-term technology positioning and strategic direction.
Serve as the primary marketing advisor for Bentley's horizontal technology portfolio.
Translate technology strategy into differentiated market positioning and strategic messaging.

Messaging, Positioning & Thought Leadership

Define messaging frameworks for Bentley's core technology platforms.
Ensure consistent positioning across industries, products, and go-to-market initiatives.
Develop differentiated value propositions grounded in customer outcomes.
Drive Bentley's technology thought leadership by identifying emerging trends and partnering with executives on key industry narratives.
Engage analysts, customers, and industry influencers to validate and strengthen Bentley's market positioning.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop a team of solution marketers.
Personally lead strategic technology solution initiatives while remaining hands-on in messaging and positioning.
Align team priorities with business objectives and evolving market opportunities.

Go-to-Market Alignment

Partner with Product Marketing, Industry Marketing, Campaigns, Sales, and Corporate Marketing to activate technology messaging globally.
Establish scalable frameworks, standards, and processes for consistent execution across the organization.

Market Insight & Technology Fluency

Maintain deep expertise in AI, digital twins, connected data, cloud platforms, and emerging enterprise technology trends.
Synthesize analyst, customer, competitive, and market insights into forward-looking positioning and strategic recommendations.

Qualifications

15+ years of experience in B2B enterprise technology marketing, including leadership in platform, AI, cloud, data, or digital transformation solutions.
Demonstrated success influencing executive leaders and shaping company-wide technology strategy and messaging.
Proven ability to lead through influence across a complex global matrix organization.
Exceptional messaging and positioning capabilities, with evidence of simplifying complex technologies.
Experience building and leading high-performing marketing teams.
Strong cross-functional leadership across product, sales, and go-to-market teams.
Technical fluency and intellectual curiosity in relevant technology domains.
Bachelor's degree required or equivalent training or experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in infrastructure, AEC, or engineering software markets.
Experience marketing horizontal technologies across multiple industries.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship.

What We Offer

A great Team and culture – please see our colleague video. 
An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction - watch this short documentary about how we got our start. 
An attractive salary and benefits package. 
A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups. 
A company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

 About Bentley Systems

Around the world, infrastructure professionals rely on software from Bentley Systems to help them design, build, and operate better and more resilient infrastructure for transportation, water, energy, cities, and more. Founded in 1984 by engineers for engineers, Bentley is the partner of choice for engineering firms and owner-operators worldwide, with software that spans engineering disciplines, industry sectors, and all phases of the infrastructure lifecycle. Through our digital twin solutions, we help infrastructure professionals unlock the value of their data to transform project delivery and asset performance. www.bentley.com

Bentley is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, pregnancy, protected veteran status, religion, national origin, age, genetic information or any other protected characteristic. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, compensation, and training. Know Your Rights as an applicant under the law.
